remarks: Welcome to this beautifully designed Art Homes property in the growing community of Elan in Beaumont. The open-concept main floor features a spacious great room, a modern kitchen with a large island, a bright dining area, a versatile main-floor den, and a convenient mudroom with access to the double attached garage.  A standout feature of this home is the rare layout offering 4 bedrooms upstairs PLUS a spacious bonus room, providing exceptional space and flexibility for growing families. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and a luxurious 5-piece ensuite, while three additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and an upper-floor laundry room complete the second level.  Thoughtfully designed with modern finishes and functional living spaces, this home is conveniently located close to parks, schools, shopping, and everyday amenities. An excellent opportunity to own a quality-built Art Homes home in one of Beaumont's newest communities. Photos are representative. (id:67522)
